SELECT t_delivery_place_depot.id, t_depot.id AS depotId, t_depot.`status`, t_depot.depot_no AS depotNo, t_depot.depot_name AS depotName, t_depot.is_port AS isPort, t_depot.is_transit AS isTransit, t_depot.depot_address AS depotAddress, t_depot.manager, t_depot.manager_telephone AS managerTelephone FROM t_delivery_place_depot LEFT JOIN t_depot ON t_delivery_place_depot.depot_no = t_depot.depot_no WHERE t_delivery_place_depot.is_deleted = #{param.deleted} AND t_delivery_place_depot.delivery_place_no = ( SELECT t_delivery_place.delivery_place_no FROM t_delivery_place WHERE t_delivery_place.id = #{param.id} )
AND t_depot.depot_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.depotNo}, '%')
AND t_depot.depot_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.depotName}, '%')
AND t_depot.is_port LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.isPort}, '%')
AND t_depot.is_transit LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.isTransit}, '%')
AND t_depot.depot_address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.depotAddress}, '%')
AND t_depot.manager LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.manager}, '%')
AND t_depot.manager_telephone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.managerTelephone}, '%')
ORDER BY t_delivery_place_depot.gmt_modified DESC
